talk.text: Wait. Is that roof actually floating?
Almost! It's the Barcelona Pavilion, designed by Mies van der Rohe and Lilly Reich in nineteen twenty-nine.

label.name: Free-standing walls
label.meta: Space that flows instead of rooms

talk.text: There aren't any. Free-standing walls guide you through, and the space just flows.
Polished stone. The pattern is the decoration.
A reflecting pool. The walls double themselves in the still water.
